full_name: Beth A. Simmons | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Social Sciences Matina S. Horner Distinguished Visiting Professor University of Pennsylvania
bio: Beth A. Simmons is the Andrea Mitchell University Professor of Law, Political Science and Business Ethics at the University of Pennsylvania. She is best known for her research on international political economy during the interwar years and on policy diffusion globally, along with her work demonstrating the influence that international law has on human rights outcomes around the world.
